texts: Traveller, your footsteps are the road, and nothing more; traveller, there is no road, the road is made by walking.
Traveller, there is no path, paths are made by walking.
Traveler, your footprints are the path and nothing more; traveler, there is no path, the path is made by walking.
Wayfarer, your footsteps alone are the path, and nothing more; wayfarer, there is no path, the path is created by walking.
